notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I have a some bug fixes!

FIXES/NEW ADDITIONS


 Added Polish translation
 Fixed Portuguese translation
 Fixed bugged ending where Roh would appear invisible after the last cutscene (Has been tested and works but if still experiencing problems please post in the discussions)

PLEASE READ!

If the game has corrupted your save file or the game is still broken, you can revert back to a previous version of the game by heading to the game's steam properties>beta>droptab>revert.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes: Firstly I'd like to apologise to everyone. Red Bow was supposed to release today, but it was knocked back due to the game logo being in the screenshots on the steam store page and it goes against their conditions. I have fixed this problem, but I have to resubmit Red Bow for a new release date. I'm hoping it will only take a few hours and I can release the game today. If not, I will keep you all informed of the new release date, but it shouldn't be too far away.

notes.title: Red Bow Set For The Steam Release January 17th (Multiple Languages Included)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/9b05aab91542d6fe120a74c02c22f610fdd09da2.jpg

We are very happy to announce the full release of Red Bow!

Wishlist/Follow on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/710600/Red_Bow/

STORY
If you were given another chance, would you take it? Or leave it in the hands of a little girl?
Play as Roh, a young girl stuck in a bizarre nightmare of dark and eerie creatures.

GAMEPLAY
This short game will have you entangled with its story-driven narrative and puzzles as you help Roh find an answer to her place in this strange world. Red Bow is designed to play and feel as a modern top down Gameboy game with roughly 1 - 2 hours of game play with achievement hunting.

The game uses an RPG top-down style which consists of finding items, secrets and solving puzzles to progress the story. The game progresses in sequences which are filled with secrets and easter eggs! Find the multiple endings by following clues and your gut!
